title: GTM Engineering Intern | Revenue Operations (d/f/m)
description:
In a nutshell: 4 to 6-month internship in our RevOps team at our Munich headquarters (hybrid), starting between February and April 2027, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role straight afterwards.

About this role at Luminovo

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we have recently expanded into North America and the rest of Europe.

GTM engineering at Luminovo is part of Revenue Operations, the department that sits between marketing, sales and customer success and makes sure our revenue organisation runs smoothly.

Our go-to-market engineering function builds the systems that find the right companies and the right people for our sales team: target lists, data enrichment, hyper-personalised outbound campaigns that signal our sellers whom to call next. We work closely with Account Executives, the BDR team and marketing and directly contribute to pipeline generation.

As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps.

There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works.

By the end of your internship, you will have shipped revenue systems that our sales & marketing teams rely on every day, and gained hands-on experience in go-to-market engineering, one of the hottest roles on the market right now!

You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows.

This role is for you

  • You combine technical thinking with commercial curiosity: perhaps you studied engineering and want to understand how companies sell, or you have discovered a passion for the commercial side of start-ups.

  • You are keen to work in a fast-paced environment and to grow alongside a high-growth start-up.

  • You bring the drive to learn quickly, a sharp analytical mind and the ambition to take on real responsibility from your first weeks. You collaborate well, ask questions without hesitation and are happy to get your hands dirty.

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You have built your own automations, workflows or tools, and can explain what you shipped and what came of it.

  • You are fluent in both German and English. Much of our outbound targets buyers in the DACH region, while the company operates in English.

  • You stand out if you have built something entrepreneurial during your studies, be it a side project, a student society or a small business.

  • You have first experience in GTM engineering, sales operations or automation (this is a big advantage but not a requirement!)

Your performance objectives

🧬 Run outbound campaigns

  • Deliver multichannel campaigns end to end. Build target lists, source and enrich the right contacts, and write the messaging in German and English.

  • Go where coverage is thin. Your campaigns will go wherever our sellers need the most support or wherever there is an opportunity worth pursuing, starting with DACH and extending to the rest of Europe and North America. Take on event campaigns, new regions and opportunistic plays, and turn them around to contribute to our pipeline.

🌀 Build signals and tooling

  • Ship signals. Build plugins or scrapers that generate high-intent leads for our sellers.

  • Process scaling. Transform website engagement into automated outbound triggers and create repeatable playbooks.

⚙️ Build automations

  • Remove manual work. Automate the repetitive manual tasks our revenue teams deal with day to day.

  • Challenge what exists. Get to know the systems we have built, then tell us where they fall short and help improve them.

💶 Unblock the sales team

  • Understand what sales reps need. Work closely with our AEs and BDRs, get to know their accounts and processes, and remove the friction that slows them down.

  • Close the loop. Feed what you learn from replies and campaign results back to sales and marketing.

🗂 Own the data

  • Own enrichment and imports. Take responsibility for account enrichment and every data import into HubSpot on contact, company and lead level.

  • Keep data accuracy high. You will be responsible for maintaining our enrichment so that data stays clean and workflows keep firing.

Your Toolkit

You will learn to work with the most modern sales automation tools on the market, such as Clay, n8n, Twain, Lusha, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and many more.

Work location

Our Munich headquarters. For your first two months you will be in the office most days, so you get to know the product, the team, our ICP and the basics of our market. After that, the role is hybrid, with the flexibility to work from home. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

Whom you will be working with

  • Max Hungenbach, Revenue Operations Team Lead and your line manager

  • Danny Bodnar, GTM Engineer, your mentor and day-to-day coach

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales. You will work directly with him on GTM strategy.

  • Dasha Vyazemskaya, Head of BDR and your partner on handing campaigns over to the BDR team

  • George Knight, Demand Generation Manager in Marketing and your partner on campaigns run alongside marketing

Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know, we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you’re interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles, see here.

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

description:

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. And we're not talking about the occasional influencer campaign. This is creator marketing at scale. Multiple campaigns, regular product launches and a constant stream of creators producing content that gets people talking.

If you love discovering great creators, know what makes content perform and get excited about turning a brief into a successful campaign, we'd love to meet you.

At Kyra, we're building a different kind of creator marketing company. We combine great people, technology and AI to make creator marketing smarter, faster and more effective.

You'll take ownership of campaigns in your market, work directly with client stakeholders and collaborate with a team that genuinely loves what it does.

Bring Campaigns to Life

  • Manage multiple creator campaigns from the initial brief through to launch, delivery and reporting.

  • Keep timelines, budgets, content approvals and deliverables moving.

  • Work closely with creators, clients and our internal teams.

  • Spot potential issues early and find solutions before they become problems.

Make the Numbers Work

  • Build creator pricing around CPV targets and expected performance.

  • Negotiate creator fees and manage campaign budgets with confidence.

  • Balance creative ambition with commercial performance.

  • Use campaign data to make smarter decisions and improve results.

  • Be a day-to-day contact for local market stakeholders.

  • Manage outreach, briefing, negotiations, contracting and content delivery.

  • Use Kyra's platform to manage campaigns from start to finish.

  • Monitor CPV, reach, engagement and other key performance metrics.

  • Use AI tools to make creator discovery, research, analysis and campaign management more efficient.

  • Keep campaign information accurate and up to date so everyone has visibility.

We move quickly, work collaboratively and care about doing great work.

With multiple campaigns running at once, staying organised, taking ownership and communicating clearly makes a huge difference.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • New briefs are picked up within 24 hours, with creator discovery and outreach underway.

  • Blockers are escalated within 3 hours so we can resolve them quickly.

  • Campaign risks and performance concerns are raised early, ideally with a suggested solution.

  • Clients and teammates receive regular updates without needing to chase.

  • Campaign information is kept accurate and up to date in our platform.

We don't expect everything to go perfectly. We do expect people to take ownership, communicate openly and work together to find solutions.

🙌 Who We're Looking For

First and foremost, we want someone who really understands creator marketing.

Someone who knows the difference between a creator with a big following and one who can actually deliver results. Someone who enjoys both the creative and commercial sides of the job.

  • Languages: For this role, you must be fluent in English and at least one additional European language (e.g. Spanish, German or French). This is an essential requirement. You must be confident communicating with creators and clients in both languages.

  • 3–5 years of experience in influencer or creator marketing.

  • Experience managing campaign budgets, negotiating creator fees and handling contracts.

  • A solid understanding of CPV and creator performance metrics.

  • Strong Excel and data skills.

  • Experience working directly with clients, ideally large consumer brands.

  • Confidence using AI tools such as Claude in your everyday work.

  • Based in Europe or the UK, with availability to work across European business hours.

Even Better If You Have

  • Experience with CPG, FMCG or other major consumer brands.

  • Experience managing high-volume or always-on creator programmes.

  • Knowledge of multiple European creator markets.

  • Experience using influencer marketing platforms.

You'll Probably Love This Role If You...

  • Spend more time than you'd like to admit discovering new creators.

  • Can spot a great creator-brand fit almost immediately.

  • Love managing lots of moving parts without dropping the details.

  • Enjoy negotiating, solving problems and making the numbers work.

  • Get excited by technology and finding smarter ways to deliver campaigns.

  • Like having real ownership and seeing the impact of your work.

✨ Interested?

If you know your local creator market, love bringing great campaigns to life and speak fluent English plus at least one additional European language, we'd love to hear from you.

💬 Creator Communications

  • Own day-to-day comms with creators and creator managers, ensuring timelines, briefs, and expectations are crystal clear

  • Manage asset submission, revisions, and general troubleshooting throughout the campaign

🗂️ Project Management & Campaign Delivery

  • Run complex, high-value campaigns under the oversight of a Senior Campaign Manager

  • Build and manage detailed project timelines—ensuring alignment across Creator Partnerships, Paid Media, Strategy, and Client Solutions

  • Flag risks early and proactively manage challenges around creators, budgets, or shifting client expectations

👥 Client Liaison & Feedback Loops

  • Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients—attending calls, sharing updates, and supporting feedback management

  • Secure client approvals on key campaign milestones and keep them aligned throughout the process

📜 Creative Briefing & Content Review

  • Lead creator briefing calls and ensure deliverables follow brand guidelines, brief requirements, and FTC compliance

  • Review creator content for quality and accuracy prior to submission

📊 Performance Tracking & Optimisation

  • Monitor campaign KPIs and update trackers daily to ensure accurate performance records

  • Collaborate with internal teams to surface insights and make data-informed recommendations for optimisation

What Success Looks Like

✅ You’re managing campaigns with confidence, structure, and precision
✅ You’re keeping clients informed, creators aligned, and timelines on track

✅ You’re delivering high-quality work that meets KPIs and strengthens client trust

title: Werkstudent Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d)
description:
Wir wollen eines der modernsten Gastronomieunternehmen werden. Und dafür entwickeln wir unsere Technologie selbst.

Vor Ort in Berlin · 15–20 Std./Woche · 17–20 €/Std. brutto · Start nach Vereinbarung

Wer wir sind

Nhas City Chicken ist eine moderne Halal-Chicken-Marke mit Standorten in Berlin und Köln. Was 1993 als Familienbetrieb begann, ist heute eine Marke mit eigenen digitalen Produkten – und einer klaren Vision: Wir wollen zeigen, wie moderne Gastronomie funktionieren kann.

Statt uns nur auf fertige Lösungen zu verlassen, entwickeln wir unsere eigenen:

  • NhasOS – unsere Software für den Betrieb: Schichtplanung, Zeiterfassung, Rechnungsfreigaben, Inventar. Beim Wareneingang erfasst das Team Mengen und Lieferschein-Foto, der Bestand aktualisiert sich automatisch.
  • Unsere Kunden-App für iOS und Android: Gäste wählen ein Zeitfenster, bestellen vor, zahlen in der App und checken per QR-Code ein.
  • Website in 10 Sprachen und Bestellportal mit Vorbestellung und Online-Zahlung.

Dabei arbeiten wir intensiv mit KI-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code – sie gehören bei uns fest zum Entwicklungsalltag.

Zeitfenster, Preise, Zahlungen, Lieferungen, Bestände: Überall steckt Logik, die stimmen muss. Und wir haben noch viel vor. Dafür suchen wir Studierende, die nicht nur Code schreiben, sondern mitgestalten wollen.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Neue Funktionen fürs Bestellportal entwickeln – im Frontend und in der API, die auch unsere Kunden-App nutzt
  • NhasOS weiterentwickeln, z. B. Rechnungsfreigaben, Inventar oder digitale Checklisten
  • Schnittstellen entwickeln und pflegen, z. B. die Kassenanbindung, die gerade entsteht
  • Tests für Zeitfenster- und Preislogik schreiben
  • Interne Abläufe automatisieren, etwa mit Python und APIs
  • Ideen von der ersten Skizze bis in den Restaurantalltag begleiten

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben – in Informatik, Wirtschafts- oder Medieninformatik oder einem anderen Fach, in dem du programmierst (z. B. Mathe, Physik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen)
  • Erste praktische Programmiererfahrung und Interesse an modernen Webtechnologien – egal ob aus Uni, Job oder eigenen Projekten
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung: Du setzt Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor oder GitHub Copilot regelmäßig in deinen Projekten ein – idealerweise hast du schon intensiv mit Claude Code und agentenbasierten Workflows gearbeitet.
  • Du behältst die Kontrolle: Du nutzt KI gezielt von der Konzeption über die Entwicklung bis zur Fehlersuche und Optimierung. Den Code, den sie schreibt, verstehst du, prüfst ihn kritisch und entwickelst ihn selbst weiter – und neue Werkzeuge probierst du gern aus.
  • Du arbeitest dich selbstständig in Neues ein, fragst, wenn du hängst, und bringst eigene Ideen ein
  • Gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Deutsch ist ein Plus, weil du dich mit den Teams in unseren Restaurants abstimmst

Womit wir arbeiten: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Supabase, Stripe, Hono auf Cloudflare Workers, Vitest. Für interne Werkzeuge: Python. Du musst nicht unseren gesamten Tech-Stack kennen. Wichtig sind solide Grundlagen und die Bereitschaft, dich einzuarbeiten.

Du musst nicht alles können. Entscheidend ist, dass du etwas bewegen und dazulernen willst.

Warum Nhas

  • Eigene Technologie statt Standardlösungen: Die Probleme kommen aus dem eigenen Restaurant – die Lösung aus dem eigenen Code.
  • Software mit echtem Impact: Gäste bestellen damit vor, Teams erfassen damit ihre Lieferungen.
  • Mitgestalten statt nur abarbeiten: Du siehst im Betrieb, ob deine Lösung funktioniert – und verbesserst sie.
  • Ein Unternehmen mit großen Zielen: Vieles, was wir vorhaben, ist noch nicht gebaut – du baust es mit.
  • Raum zum Wachsen: Du vertiefst KI-gestützte Entwicklung an Software, die jeden Tag im Betrieb läuft.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vergütung: 17–20 € brutto pro Stunde, je nach Vorkenntnissen und praktischer Erfahrung
  • Arbeitszeit: 15–20 Std./Woche, möglichst flexibel und mit deinem Studium vereinbar
  • Arbeitsort: vor Ort in Berlin
  • Start: nach Vereinbarung
  • Betreuung: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Lead Developer zusammen

Bereit, mit uns etwas aufzubauen?

Wir suchen Menschen, die neugierig sind, gern Dinge entwickeln und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns an der Gastronomie von morgen zu arbeiten.

Zeig uns, was du kannst. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung – ein GitHub-Profil oder eigene Projekte helfen, sind aber kein Muss. Ein kurzer Lebenslauf reicht.

Let's build what's next.

title: Praktikum Sales & Business Development (m/w/d)
description:
Über SEOMATIK

SEOMATIK ist eine Agentur für digitales Wachstum. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre Sichtbarkeit zu erhöhen, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und digitale Wachstumschancen zu nutzen. Unsere Leistungen umfassen unter anderem SEO, GEO, SEA, Social Media, digitale Strategien und innovative KI-Lösungen.

Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Kundenportfolios suchen wir einen engagierten Praktikanten (m/w/d), der uns im Bereich Sales & Business Development unterstützt.

Du arbeitest direkt an unserer Neukundengewinnung mit und erhältst Einblicke in den gesamten Vertriebsprozess.

  • Lead Research: Du recherchierst Unternehmen, die als potenzielle Kunden für SEOMATIK infrage kommen.
  • Markt- und Branchenanalysen: Du identifizierst interessante Branchen, Zielgruppen und Geschäftspotenziale.
  • Lead-Qualifizierung: Du analysierst potenzielle Kunden, ihre Websites, ihre digitale Präsenz und mögliche Marketingpotenziale.
  • Vertriebsstrategien: Du unterstützt uns bei der Entwicklung neuer Ideen und Strategien zur Kundengewinnung.
  • Kundenansprache: Du hilfst bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung individueller B2B-Akquise über LinkedIn, E-Mail und weitere geeignete Kanäle.
  • Sales-Kampagnen: Du wirkst bei der Planung und Umsetzung gezielter Akquisekampagnen mit.
  • CRM & Leadmanagement: Du dokumentierst Kontakte, strukturierst Vertriebsaktivitäten und unterstützt die Nachverfolgung potenzieller Kunden.
  • KI & Automatisierung: Du lernst, wie moderne KI-Tools die Recherche, Analyse und Vertriebsarbeit unterstützen können.

Das bringst du mit

  • Interesse an Vertrieb, Marketing, Business Development oder Unternehmensführung.
  • Freude daran, Unternehmen zu analysieren und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu entdecken.
  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen.
  • Neugier auf digitale Technologien und künstliche Intelligenz.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen digitalen Anwendungen.
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit LinkedIn, CRM-Systemen oder Online Marketing sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung.
  • Echte Einblicke in den Vertrieb einer Online-Marketing-Agentur.
  • Aktive Mitarbeit an konkreten Projekten statt reiner Beobachtung.
  • Freiraum für eigene Ideen und kreative Vertriebsansätze.
  • Einblicke in moderne Technologien, KI-Anwendungen und automatisierte Vertriebsprozesse.
  • Die Möglichkeit, eigenständig Verantwortung zu übernehmen und wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln.
  • Persönliche Betreuung und regelmäßiges Feedback.

Warum dieses Praktikum?

Du möchtest nicht nur theoretisch lernen, wie Unternehmen neue Kunden gewinnen, sondern selbst daran mitarbeiten?

Bei SEOMATIK lernst du, wie man attraktive Zielkunden identifiziert, Geschäftspotenziale erkennt, überzeugende Vertriebsstrategien entwickelt und daraus konkrete Kundenkontakte entstehen lässt.

Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Erzähl uns kurz, warum dich Vertrieb und Business Development interessieren und weshalb du gerne bei SEOMATIK mitarbeiten möchtest.

Doch Innovation allein ist nicht alles – wir setzen genauso auf ein wertschätzendes und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich jeder individuell entfalten kann. Wir suchen ein Kommunikationstalent mit Begeisterung für digitale Lösungen und einem guten Gespür für Menschen und Märkte. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Kundenmanagement. Darüber hinaus findest du dich in folgenden Punkten wieder:

  • Du bist kommunikationsstark, überzeugend und trittst professionell auf.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und zielorientiert
  • Du packst gerne an, findest pragmatische Lösungen und gehst Herausforderungen mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität und Eigeninitiative an.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir.

Unser Team ist unser größtes Kapital, und das soll auch so bleiben. Deshalb sorgen wir dafür, dass du dich bei uns wohlfühlst und weiterentwickeln kannst. Bei uns erwarten dich:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine zielführende Work-Life-Balance.

  • Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven mit spannenden Entwicklungs- und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Zero-touch onboarding: within six months, a new hire's accounts, apps and access provision automatically from Humaans through Okta, and their laptop self-enrols — day one setup takes minutes, not hours

  • Self-service by default: within nine months, the top twenty employee IT requests — access, kit, resets, software — are self-served through automation, chat or a vending machine, not a ticket to a person

  • Automated joiner/mover/leaver: within twelve months, role changes and offboarding run automatically from the HRIS, with access removed same-day and hardware recovered

  • Build over buy: you ship internal tooling and coding agent workflows that remove manual steps, so the function scales on automation, not headcount

  • Secure and audit-ready: the fleet stays managed and SOC 2 evidence generates itself, rather than being assembled by hand before an audit

  • a software engineer who likes owning systems end to end and wants a broad, high-ownership remit

  • a DevOps, SRE or platform engineer who automates infrastructure and wants to point that at people and devices

  • a strong IT or systems person who already codes and automates rather than clicking through consoles

  • someone from a smaller company or an MSP who has wired up tools, identity and devices and scripted the boring parts away

What matters is the instinct to automate anything you have to do twice, and to build the tool rather than do the task. We'll teach the IT domain to a strong builder — we won't teach someone to be a builder.

How we work

This role is on-site in Edinburgh, reporting into Security — you'll be hands-on with the actual fleet, not just its dashboards. It's a high-trust environment: you own the systems you build, end to end, with light process and a bias toward shipping.

About Flow

Flow Engineering is an AI-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor.

About the role

Flow is seeking a Solutions Architect (Sales Engineer) to be the technical partner in our sales process. Our buyers are systems and engineering leaders at aerospace, defense, automotive, and hardware companies, and they need to see how Flow fits their real workflows before they commit. You will run technical discovery, demos, and pilots, and you will be the person who can answer the hard questions in the room.

This role pairs closely with our account executives. They own the commercial relationship, and you own the technical win: showing the product, mapping it to the customer's engineering process, and making sure a pilot proves out what it needs to.

What you'll do

  • Partner with account executives on discovery calls, technical demos, and pilots, from first technical conversation through to a signed deal.

  • Understand each customer's engineering workflow and requirements process, then show how Flow fits it.

  • Build and run demos and proofs of concept that reflect the customer's actual use case rather than a generic script.

  • Answer technical and security questions from engineering, IT, and security teams, and complete security questionnaires with support from the team.

  • Work with product and engineering to feed back what customers need and where the product should go next.

  • Partner with forward deployed engineers to hand off pilots cleanly into deployment.

About you

  • 4+ years in sales engineering, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, or a technical customer-facing role.

  • Comfortable running a technical room, from individual engineers up to VPs, and adjusting the conversation to each.

  • Strong technical foundation: you can reason about APIs, integrations, and how software fits into an existing engineering stack.

  • Able to translate between what a customer says they need and what the product actually does.

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving environment where the sales motion and the product are both still taking shape.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with requirements, systems engineering, PLM, or ALM tooling (Jama, DOORS, etc.)

  • Background in or selling into defense, aerospace, or regulated hardware environments.

title: Product & Regulatory Counsel
description:
Tired of meeting the product at the terms and conditions stage?

Most product lawyers see the flow once it's built and the launch date is set. Here, you're on the whiteboard at ideation, so compliant by design is the plan, not the clean-up.

And the stakes are real. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries, and is now building wallets, cards and broader financial products for diaspora communities.

The job

You'll advise on new licensing and products from first idea to go-live, and own regulator engagement across our markets.

  • Shape products before they're built: review designs, UX, flows and terms against regulatory and customer-outcome rules, Consumer Duty included, while change is still cheap.

  • Turn regulation into decisions: what's mandatory, what's prudent, and the alternative route that still gets it launched.

  • Own the regulator relationship: across our markets, including new ones, and flag what regulatory change means for the roadmap early.

  • Take products to new countries: localise what already works, with country leads and local counsel.

  • Build the playbooks: templates that let Legal scale without adding friction.

Why you'll want it

Spend your time on the hard questions. You're asked to shape our roadmap and launches, and understand how to fit them to the relevant regimes

Be a peer, with room to run. You'll join a flat team of regulatory and commercial lawyers, with real autonomy and a manager who trusts you.

Make launches faster, not slower. Legal in the room from day one is how products here ship sooner. That's the whole point of your seat.

Make sending money home cheaper. Remittances pay for school fees, rent and medical bills, and are worth more than all foreign aid combined. Cheaper, reliable transfers put more of that money in families' hands.

Is this you?

You're a qualified lawyer (UK or equivalent) with 4+ years' PQE in payments, e-money or financial services regulation, at a firm, a regulator or a fintech.

You've advised payments or e-money firms under the FCA or an equivalent regime, dealt with the regulator directly, and helped product teams take live launches over the line.

You give the answer first and the reasoning second. Ambiguity across several jurisdictions doesn't stop you making the call.

If you'd rather be asked first than asked last, apply. Missing a box or two? Send your CV anyway.

title: Talent Partner
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Talent Partner at Faculty, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process, attracting and engaging exceptional talent to power our high-growth business goals. Operating within our People team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers across all levels while driving an inclusive, world-class candidate experience within the commercial space and across our Central Functions.

This is an opportunity to shape our hiring strategy, solve complex talent challenges, and directly contribute to building a world-leading AI organisation.

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning the recruitment lifecycle from initial scoping through to interviewing, offer management, and candidate onboarding.

  • Sourcing passive talent creatively across platforms like LinkedIn, networking channels, and referrals to build diverse candidate pipelines.

  • Partnering closely with business leaders as a trusted advisor, offering data-backed insights and guiding recruitment strategy.

  • Designing structured interview packs and assessment criteria to ensure objective, high-quality hiring decisions.

  • Driving diversity and inclusion initiatives throughout every step of the hiring funnel.

  • Analysing recruitment data and pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and optimize process performance.

  • Amplifying Faculty’s employer brand by representing the company at industry events, conferences, and meetups.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring experience managing end-to-end talent acquisition processes, ideally within a fast-moving, in-house environment within the commercial and/or GTM space.

  • You possess strong direct-sourcing skills and know how to leverage modern applicant tracking systems to engage top-tier passive candidates.

  • You excel at stakeholder management, building authentic relationships across all levels while balancing support with constructive challenge.

  • You take an agile, problem-solving approach to recruitment, adapting quickly to change while upholding high standards of confidentiality and compliance.

  • You prioritise quality over volume, demonstrating resilience and a dedication to delivering an outstanding, inclusive candidate experience.

  • You are a confident, articulate communicator who thrives as a brand ambassador, passionately sharing our culture and ambition with prospective talent.

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial Talent Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introductory interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins)

  3. Competency & Scenario based interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Credit Analyst
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Primary analysis – Review new debt transactions in the high yield and leveraged loan market, ensuring we produce quick and insightful reports

  • Secondary analysis – With guidance from senior analysts, deep dive into high yield earnings reports, provide financial updates on specific credits, and produce market-leading predictive analysis and industry research

  • Relationship & product evangelism – Support clients, answer questions on our platform and provide insight. Gather feedback and work with the product team to develop the 9fin offering, taking the lead on new and exciting developments

About You

This role will be a great fit if you demonstrate:

  • A strong interest in financial markets, and a desire to learn about how they work

  • Strong communication and writing skills – Demonstrate clear and effective written and verbal communication, producing clean, timely, and accurate copy in a concise manner. Exhibit excellent attention to detail

  • Problem solving – Enjoy interpreting information and constructing effective solutions to complex problems. Be a team player, but also able to effectively work alone (although help is always on hand if you need)

  • Drive – Bring an inquisitive and passionate mindset, demonstrating a strong interest in the development and dynamics of financial (and especially) capital markets. A self-starter, you are up for the challenge of a role that will morph and transform as we continue to grow

We’re open to candidates from a range of backgrounds – if you’re curious, analytical, and enjoy working with financial data, we’d love to hear from you!

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive salary benchmarked at 75-90th% of market

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

The team

We are a mission-driven team of 80 engineers based in London and the surrounding areas, united by the challenge of fixing healthcare communication. We are innovating for the NHS at a scale and depth that has never been done before, solving the real-world problems that stand between millions of patients and the care they need.

We are a highly cross-functional group where engineering, product, data, and security collaborate as true peers. We foster a low-ego, high-impact environment that values expertise and new ideas, maintaining the high standards required to build and scale a national healthcare communication platform. Within this ecosystem, our teams operate with high autonomy, owning everything from initial system design to long-term service stability.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of our Analytics Engineering, Product, and ML teams, designing and scaling the pipelines and data architecture that everything else is built on, and building the foundations that turn data from a support function into a strategic asset.

Challenges you’ll solve…

  • You will design and scale a robust data architecture that handles massive event-driven communication flows across nearly every GP practice in the UK.

  • You will build and own ingestion and ELT pipelines end-to-end, from source systems through to our Snowflake data warehouse, using Python and SQL in production.

  • You will make and own architectural decisions that support analytics, experimentation and machine learning at scale.

  • You will partner closely with Analytics Engineering, Product and ML teams to turn raw healthcare communication data into reliable, high-performance datasets they can build on.

  • You will set and uphold standards for data integrity, security and reliability, in an environment where getting data right is part of keeping patients safe.

  • You will lay the data foundations for our AI and ML work, helping take models from experimentation into production.

  • You will take on greenfield problems, shaping how data works at Accurx from the ground up.

  • You will mentor teammates and contribute to a strong engineering culture through rigorous code reviews, sprint planning and open collaboration.

You should apply if…

  • You have strong, proven experience as a Data Engineer, designing and building ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines from scratch using Python and SQL in production environments.

  • You have a deep understanding of modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift, and transformation tools like dbt, with a focus on creating clean, reliable and reusable datasets.

  • You are comfortable owning decisions around data architecture, and working with cloud environments and software engineering best practices like Git and CI/CD.

  • You have experience, or a strong interest, in building and operationalising machine learning models, and understand how strong data foundations enable better AI outcomes.

  • You think beyond pipelines. You care about how data drives real-world outcomes, especially in healthcare, and can work cross-functionally to shape problems and deliver solutions.

  • You actively leverage AI tools to automate routine tasks and continuously explore ways to integrate AI into your workflows, improving quality and speed.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers.

  • £85,000 - £105,000 base salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £30,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £85K – £105K • Offers Equity

We’re looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join our growing team on a fixed-term contract from November 2026 to January 2027, supporting us through Black Friday and our seasonal peak. The role is 37.5 hours a week, reports to the Customer Service Manager, and is hybrid between home and our office.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Provide the highest standard of service across live chat, WhatsApp, email, Instagram DMs and social media comments, using TALA’s brand tone of voice.

  • Prioritise live channels and manage several conversations at once, aiming for high first-time resolution with informative, caring replies.

  • Help customers with order tracking and delivery queries, including delays and parcels marked as delivered but not received, working with our fulfilment partner and couriers.

  • Support returns, refunds and exchanges: guide customers through our returns portal, process returns accurately and keep customers updated on their status.

  • Handle faulty, missing, incorrect and damaged item claims: gather evidence, follow agreed processes and escalate using our escalation matrix.

  • Give confident product, sizing and fit advice so customers buy the right size first time, and answer stock, restock and promotion questions during Black Friday and the Winter Sale.

  • Process order changes, cancellations and address updates within agreed timeframes.

  • Respond to customer feedback and product reviews, both positive and negative, and pass on any action or feedback needed.

  • Liaise with the brand and social media teams so replies follow our brand guidelines, and stay up to date on planned launches and social activity.

  • Act as the voice of the customer: share product feedback, recurring issues and ideas to improve our FAQs and help centre, so customers can self-serve 24/7.

  • Use and help maintain macros and template replies, tagging tickets accurately so our reporting stays reliable.

  • Work towards daily productivity targets, handling queues in the agreed priority order.

  • As part of the wider Customer Service team, support other tasks during busy periods when needed.

What we’re looking for:

  • Our customer service team operates 7 days a week between 08:00 and 20:00, so you’ll work a rota that includes weekends, some bank holidays and selected dates over Christmas and New Year. During launches and peak periods we occasionally work outside normal business hours.

  • Experience using Gorgias, Shopify, our SWAP returns, Monday.com and Slack is ideal, though not essential as training will be provided.

  • Previous customer service experience, focused on written communication (email, chat and social media)

  • Experience responding to and moderating social media channels.

  • Strong IT skills and confidence learning multiple platforms, some of them bespoke.

  • Fast, accurate typing and clear, friendly written English, with strong attention to detail.

  • The ability to stay calm and kind with challenging customers while sticking to policy.

  • Problem-solving skills, thinking quickly and creatively to find solutions for our customers.

  • Strong time and task management, and the ability to juggle several conversations at pace.

  • A personality that thrives in a fast-moving, quickly changing environment, with the willingness to try new things and take initiative, using good judgement to resolve issues or escalate for support.

  • A passion for great customer experiences, keeping the customer at the heart of everything you do.

  • This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for their next challenge in a well-funded, fast-paced and high-growth ecommerce start-up

title: Animateur réseaux magasins (H/F)
description:
Le Groupe Cybertek est un acteur majeur dans le secteur de la vente de matériel informatique et High-Tech en France. Créé en 1996, son siège social et ses plateformes logistiques se trouvent à Bordeaux. Cybertek possède 28 magasins sous les enseignes Cybertek et Grosbill, ainsi que cinq sites de commerce en ligne. Employant 270 personnes, Cybertek a réussi à atteindre un chiffre d'affaires annuel de plus de 100 millions d'euros en s’appuyant sur des équipes dynamiques et soudées. Le Groupe Cybertek affirme son engagement en faveur de l’égalité professionnelle entre les femmes et les hommes et veille à promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif, notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap.

Vos missions

Au cœur de nos magasins répartis sur toute la France lors de vos déplacements quotidiens, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans leur bon fonctionnement, l’accompagnement des équipes et le développement du chiffre d’affaires.

Réaliser le suivi des magasins définis :

  • Vérifier et contribuer à la mise en place d’une organisation permettant d’assurer le bon fonctionnement du point de vente (application et respect des procédures internes) ;
  • Veiller et participer à l’amélioration de l’image de marque du point de vente (présentation, ponctualité, propreté, accueil des clients, accueil téléphonique, rappel des clients, relationnel, etc.) ;
  • Contrôler les points de vente (stocks, activités réalisées au sein du point de vente, horaires d’ouverture) ;
  • Contrôler et analyser l’activité commerciale du magasin (devis, commandes, factures, chiffre d’affaires, résultats, objectifs) ;
  • Motiver, accompagner et soutenir les équipes ainsi que le Responsable dans le développement du chiffre d’affaires du point de vente ;
  • Assurer un soutien des équipes par une présence régulière dans chaque point de vente ;
  • Assurer les remplacements en magasin si nécessaires ;
  • Réaliser un entretien mensuel avec chaque Responsable afin d’évaluer l’avancement des objectifs, d’identifier les éventuelles difficultés et de prendre les décisions nécessaires en conséquence ;

Suivi des interventions et coordination avec la Direction :

  • Réaliser un rapport sur chaque passage et contrôle d’un point de vente
  • Analyser les données ;
  • Assurer un point régulier avec la Direction au cours d’entretiens ponctuels, par téléphone plusieurs fois par semaine ;
  • Organiser une réunion tous les quinze jours afin de réaliser un point détaillé sur chaque point de vente et de définir les futures interventions ;
  • Réaliser une réunion mensuelle avec la Direction afin de produire un bilan du mois écoulé et de définir les objectifs du mois suivant ;
  • Animer une réunion mensuelle avec les différents services du siège social du Groupe Cybertek en lien avec les magasins, afin d’identifier les difficultés rencontrées et d’améliorer la communication et la coordination entre les différents services (SAV, Technique, Stock, Administratif, etc.) ;

L’animation commerciale :

  • Animer les magasins et organiser les journées portes ouvertes (salons, partenariats, etc.) ;
  • Assurer le facing des magasins et veiller à la bonne présentation de l’offre produit et des produits en démonstration ;Assurer le suivi et le reporting des incentives et des différentes opérations commerciales.

Vos compétences

Vous justifiez d’une expérience dans le suivi et le contrôle de points de vente, idéalement dans le secteur de l’informatique ou de l’high-tech. Rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse des performances commerciales, le suivi des stocks et le contrôle du respect des procédures.

Vous savez accompagner et soutenir les équipes et les Responsables de magasin dans l’atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en identifiant les éventuels axes d’amélioration. Autonome, réactif(ve) et force de proposition, vous appréciez le travail de terrain, les déplacements et les échanges avec les différents services.

Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et contribuer activement à la performance et au bon fonctionnement de nos points de vente ? Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Contrôleur(se) Magasins !

title: Directeur Exploitation Datacenters – Infrastructures Critiques (H/F)
description:
Head of DC Operations (H/F)

Région parisienne

Votre mission

Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne.

Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance.

Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes.

Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service.

Important – Nature du profil recherché

Nous recherchons un/e professionnel/le de l'exploitation technique de datacenters (Data Center Operations / Critical Facilities), et non un Directeur des Systèmes d'Information ou un Directeur des infrastructures IT.

Une expérience concrète du pilotage opérationnel des infrastructures physiques critiques est indispensable : installations électriques (HT/BT), UPS, groupes électrogènes, systèmes de refroidissement (CVC), maintenance préventive et corrective, gestion des incidents et continuité de service.

Les profils exclusivement orientés IT, systèmes, réseaux, cloud, hébergement ou gestion de projets informatiques ne correspondent pas au périmètre du poste.

Vos responsabilités

Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites

  • Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires.

  • Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites.

  • Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures.

  • Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives.

  • Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques.

Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation

  • Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences.

  • Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action.

  • Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes.

  • Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge.

  • Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites.

  • Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise.

Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques

  • Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques.

  • Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité.

  • Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques.

  • Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires.

  • Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service.

Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs

  • Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients.

  • Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients.

  • Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires.

  • Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations.

  • Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires.

Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue

  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre.

  • Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables.

  • Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide.

  • Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques.

  • Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable.

  • Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité.

  • Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles.

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise des enjeux d'exploitation des data centers et compréhension des architectures électriques, mécaniques, CVC, de protection incendie, de GTB/BMS et des systèmes de contrôle.

  • Maîtrise du pilotage de la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire.

  • Connaissance des SLA, KPI de disponibilité, capacité, qualité de service et performance énergétique.

  • Capacité à analyser et challenger les risques techniques, les plans de maintenance et les investissements.

  • Maîtrise des enjeux budgétaires OPEX/CAPEX et des exigences réglementaires applicables.

Qualités personnelles

  • Leadership et capacité à manager des responsables expérimentés.

  • Crédibilité technique et sens des responsabilités.

  • Capacité à structurer une organisation, harmoniser les pratiques et conduire le changement.

  • Aptitude à fédérer les équipes et à développer la coopération transverse.

  • Capacité de décision, d'arbitrage et de priorisation.

  • Sang-froid en situation de crise, rigueur et orientation résultats.

  • Sens du client et capacité à construire des relations de partenariat durables.

Langues : français courant et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Les enjeux de réussite

Au cours des premiers mois, vous aurez notamment pour objectifs de construire une feuille de route opérationnelle claire, de consolider le pilotage par les indicateurs, de hiérarchiser les risques et de définir les moyens nécessaires à leur traitement.

Vous contribuerez également à renforcer la cohésion managériale, à harmoniser les pratiques entre les sites et à accompagner l'évolution de l'organisation dans une logique durable de performance et d'amélioration continue.

Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise des infrastructures critiques au service d'un environnement exigeant, avec une forte dimension managériale, stratégique et transverse ?

title: Telecom security trainer
description:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces.

Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub).

Job Description

Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions

We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide.

Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies.

This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives.

  • Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team.

  • Adapt existing online curriculum, presentations, exercises, and lab materials for engaging live classroom delivery.

  • Explain signaling flows, trust boundaries, protocol vulnerabilities, attack scenarios, and defensive controls clearly and accurately.

  • Facilitate hands-on exercises in authorized, controlled lab environments and help participants troubleshoot technical issues.

  • Answer participant questions on telecom security, including detection, mitigation, and operational defense strategies.

  • Check participants’ understanding through practical exercises, discussion, and knowledge checks.

  • Coordinate classroom and lab readiness with P1 Security and the client before delivery.

  • Gather participant feedback and share recommendations to improve course content and delivery.

  • Respect client confidentiality, intellectual property, and agreed rules of engagement throughout each mission.

Required qualifications

  • Deep telecom security expertise in one or more of the following domains:

  • SS7 / SIGTRAN: MAP/CAP signaling, common abuse scenarios, and signaling security controls. Related course: TS-201 — 2G, 3G and SS7 Mobile Network Security.

  • LTE / Diameter: S6a, Gx, and Gy interfaces, protocol vulnerabilities, and defensive measures. Related course: TS-401 — LTE Security and Insecurity.

  • GTP-C: Versions 1 and 2, control-plane procedures, security risks, and mitigation strategies. Related training tracks: TS-201 — 2G/3G and TS-401 — LTE / EPC, depending on the mission scope.

  • IMS / SIP: Signaling fundamentals, protocol weaknesses, and protection mechanisms. Related course: TS-250 — IMS Security.

  • 5G: Service-based architecture (SBA), HTTP/2 and JSON-based APIs, and interconnect security involving N32 and the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP). Related course: TS-501 — 5G Telecom Security hands-on course.

  • You do not need to cover every domain to apply. Specialists in one or several domains are welcome. Missions will be matched to your demonstrated expertise; please indicate the courses and topics you are confident teaching independently.

  • Proven experience delivering technical training, workshops, or hands-on instruction to engineering or SOC teams.

  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts, manage classroom discussion, and adapt to mixed levels of experience.

  • Practical experience analyzing telecom signaling traces and using packet-analysis tools such as Wireshark.

  • Confidence working with Linux-based lab environments and troubleshooting connectivity or exercise issues.

  • Professional preparation, reliable delivery, and clear communication with clients and the P1 Security team.

  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally for short-term onsite engagements: typically around five days per mission including travel, with some engagements requiring up to two weeks onsite.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in telecom security consulting, penetration testing, incident response, signaling monitoring, or mobile core network operations.

  • Familiarity with 3GPP security specifications and relevant GSMA signaling security guidance.

  • Experience with signaling firewalls, roaming and interconnect security, or telecom threat detection.

  • Experience adapting digital learning content into instructor-led courses and practical exercises.

  • Familiarity with virtualized or containerized lab environments and scripting for lab preparation.

  • Experience teaching international audiences or working across different cultural and organizational contexts.

Language requirements

  • Fluent professional English, with the ability to deliver technical instruction and facilitate discussions.

  • Additional languages are a plus, including French.

Engagement details

  • Contract type: Freelance, on a per-mission basis.

  • Delivery location: Onsite at client locations worldwide.

  • Mission duration: Typically around five days including travel; some engagements may require up to two weeks onsite.

  • Headquarters: Paris, France.

  • Training materials: Established curriculum and lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform, adapted for each classroom engagement.

  • Commercial arrangements: Scope, preparation time, delivery dates, fees, and travel and accommodation arrangements to be agreed for each mission.

Hiring process

  • First contact call (10-20min)

  • Direct manager call (30min)

  • Capability assessment exercice (depending on position)

  • C-level & Director call (30 min)

Contact

If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field.

To apply, please send your CV or professional profile and a short introduction highlighting your telecom security expertise and training experience. Include the protocols and courses you can teach, examples of previous workshops or audiences, your availability, your location and travel flexibility, and your indicative daily rate. Please do not include confidential client information.

Website - www.P1sec.com

Premier opérateur public européen de traitement et de valorisation des déchets, le Syctom, l’agence métropolitaine des déchets ménagers, est un acteur majeur de l'économie circulaire et de la ville durable.

Au service de 81 communes franciliennes et de près de 6 millions d'habitants, le Syctom accomplit sa mission de service public avec pour objectif de faire des déchets une ressource.

Une mission exigeante qu'il conduit grâce à ses 145 collaboratrices et collaborateurs et 7 apprenti.es, en lien étroit avec les collectivités adhérentes (Ville de Paris et 10 Etablissements publics territoriaux du Grand Paris) en charge de la collecte des déchets et l'ensemble des acteurs de la filière.

Le budget annuel s’élève à 822 M€ et le Plan des Investissements 825 M€ d’ici 2030.

Le Syctom traite et valorise chaque année 2,2 millions de tonnes de déchets ménagers dans ses unités de traitement innovantes (3 unités de valorisation énergétique - UVE -, 5 centres de tri, 2 centres de transfert et une future unité de Biométhanisation). Le patrimoine du syndicat, alliant performance industrielle et exemplarité environnementale, est exploité sous contrat par des entreprises privées ou des SemOp présidées par un.e élu.e du syndicat.

Acteur responsable et innovant, le Syctom est engagé en première ligne dans la dynamique de transition écologique française. Il accompagne le développement de la collecte des déchets alimentaires, développe des solutions de traitement et de valorisation, agit en faveur de la réduction et du tri des déchets et s’engage dans la réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre (GES) liées à ses activités de transport et de logistique.

La Direction générale adjointe Ressources et moyens (DGARM) pilote les moyens financiers, humains, informatiques, juridiques et logistiques ainsi que du fonctionnement de l’institution et des actions œuvrant à la qualité de vie au travail. Elle accompagne les directions opérationnelles au quotidien, pilote des processus et démarches collectives et participe au projet stratégique de la collectivité, qui définit des orientations communes afin que le Syctom accompagne au mieux le territoire dans ses ambitions de développement durable.

Acteur clé de la performance et de la soutenabilité financière du Syctom, la Direction des Finances assure le pilotage des ressources financières de l’établissement. Elle accompagne les projets stratégiques de la collectivité en apportant son expertise en matière de planification et d’ingénierie financière, de construction budgétaire, de tarification et de financement des investissements, dans un environnement institutionnel, réglementaire et économique contraint et en constante évolution.

Dans un contexte de structuration et de modernisation de ses fonctions ressources, le Syctom mène actuellement un audit stratégique visant à renforcer la fonction financière et à développer une culture de pilotage et de contrôle de gestion. Celle-ci vise à consolider les capacités d'analyse et d'anticipation de l'établissement, à développer une culture de pilotage de la performance et à renforcer les outils d'aide à la décision au service de la Direction générale et des élu.es.

Missions

Sous la responsabilité du Directeur général adjoint Ressources et moyens, vous pilotez la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie financière et budgétaire de la collectivité. Le budget 2026 s’élève à 479 M€ en fonctionnement et 343 M€ en investissement. Le montant de la contribution acquittée par les collectivités membres du syndicat est de 268 M€.

A partir d’hypothèses que vous coordonnez et documentez en lien avec les directions opérationnelles, vous réalisez des prospectives financières pluriannuelles. Dans ce cadre, vous êtes chargé.e de structurer un dialogue de gestion budgétaire qui permette d’optimiser les moyens financiers du Syctom et de piloter au plus juste le montant de redevance acquittée par les collectivités membres. Vous proposez un cadrage financier et pilotez les processus et calendriers budgétaires en lien avec les directions opérationnelles.

Dans le cadre de la feuille de route, vous êtes force de proposition et préparez, sous la responsabilité de la Direction générale, les travaux et décisions des élu.es quant à la trajectoire financière et tarifaire du syndicat. Vous conduisez les analyses financières en vue de déterminer les risques et opportunités à court et long termes, et proposez des scénarios à la Direction générale. Vous construisez et pilotez des indicateurs financiers clés et proposez des outils d’aide à la décision pour la Direction générale et l’exécutif, en développant le SI décisionnel financier.

Avec une dette de près d'un milliard d'euros, vous définissez et proposez à la Direction générale une stratégie de financement à long terme garantissant la soutenabilité financière des projets du syndicat. Vous supervisez la gestion active de la dette, de la trésorerie, des recettes et des financements externes.

Vous assurez également le pilotage financier du patrimoine industriel du Syctom et accompagnez la définition des trajectoires financières nécessaires au financement des charges futures induites par les investissements structurants, notamment en matière d'amortissements, de fiscalité et de coûts d'exploitation des nouvelles installations.

À ce titre, vous apportez une expertise de haut niveau en matière de fiscalité locale et de fiscalité des activités industrielles. Vous pilotez les démarches d'optimisation et de sécurisation des charges fiscales du syndicat et contribuez à la mise en place de processus et d'outils fiabilisés, en lien avec les directions techniques, patrimoniales et d'exploitation.

Le Syctom s’est engagé dans la création de SemOp pour l’exploitation de ses sites, dans le cadre de marchés publics. Vous participez activement à la mise en place des moyens de suivi et de contrôle financier de ces structures pour le compte du Syctom, en lien avec la gouvernance et les équipes qui qui en assurent la maîtrise technique et le contrôle des contrats. Vous assurez également le suivi des structures desquelles le Syctom est actionnaire (Semardel, Sigeif Mobilités).

Vous accompagnez la Direction générale dans le dialogue financier avec les collectivités adhérentes et contribuez à la pédagogie des enjeux financiers du syndicat auprès des élu.es et partenaires institutionnels tels que les établissements bancaires ou les agences de notation.

Dans un contexte de transformation de la fonction financière, vous encadrez une équipe et participez à des projets structurants visant à renforcer les outils de pilotage et le contrôle de gestion, avec l’opportunité de contribuer directement à l’évolution de l’organisation, des pratiques et des processus du syndicat.

Ce poste offre ainsi l'opportunité de contribuer directement à la transformation financière du premier acteur public européen du traitement des déchets ménagers, dans un environnement conjuguant enjeux industriels, financiers et environnementaux de premier plan.

Profil

De formation supérieure (Bac+5) en Finances publiques, vous disposez d'une expérience réussie en direction ou en pilotage financier et budgétaire d’un organisme public.

Vous détenez une expertise dans le domaine de la préparation et l'éxécution budgétaire comme dans la stratégie financière. Aguerri.e aux outils et processus associés, vous savez également les faire évoluer dans une perspective d'amélioration continue, et détenez une appétence pour les questions organisationnelles.

Vous avez une vision stratégique des enjeux financiers et budgétaires d’une collectivité, et avez la capacité à synthétiser et proposer une feuille de route et des options à des fins d'aide à la décision pour la Direction générale.

Pédagogue, réactif.ve et proactif.ve vous savez impulser et mener un dialogue de qualité avec les directions opérationnelles. Vous savez porter un projet et aider à la décision. title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
description:
THE POSITION

ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory.

This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented.

Missions :

  • Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge).

  • Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods.

  • Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup.

  • Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods.

You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team.

Location: Toulouse (city centre)

Start: As soon as possible

Duration: 6 months

Profile

  • Bac+5 - Engineering school / Master in applied mathematics, signal and image processing, machine learning and/or electromagnetics

  • Programming skills (preferably Python), experience with a deep learning framework

  • Knowledge of inverse problems or infrared cameras is a plus

  • Team spirit, proactive attitude and good communication skills in an interdisciplinary team
